title: Avatar Medical da Kyber Sun Samu Tallafin Yuro Miliyan 3.7 don Faɗaɗa Damar Amfani da Hotunan Likitanci na 3D Masu Nutsarwa a Asibitoci
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Mu'amala da hotunan likitanci kai tsaye nan take na ɗaya daga cikin matsalolin jinkiri mafiya wahala da ake da su,” in ji Jean-Baptiste Kempf, CEO na Kyber. “Jinkirin da ba za a ma lura da shi ba a kiran bidiyo yakan ɓata hoton gaba ɗaya idan kowane ido na karɓar nasa hoton daban. Warware wannan matsala ita ce ke buɗe ƙofar komai. Ta hanyar haɗa fasahar nuna hotuna masu nutsarwa ta Avatar Medical da tsarin ginshiƙin yaɗa bidiyo kai tsaye na Kyber, an tsara MediVerse ne domin wannan mu'amala ta gudana ba tare da tangarɗa ba a wurare da na'urori daban-daban. html:
Avatar Medical da Kyber a yau sun sanar da cewa an ba su tallafin da ya kai har Yuro miliyan 3.7 ta hannun shirin France 2030 na gwamnatin Faransa, domin haɓaka Avatar MediVerse, wani aiki da aka tsara don samar da hotunan likitanci na 3D masu nutsarwa, waɗanda aka keɓance wa kowane mara lafiya, a duk inda likitoci da marasa lafiya ke buƙatarsu.

A halin yanzu, nuna wa mara lafiya ko likita tsarin jikin ɗan adam a cikin ainihin 3D ba tare da tabarau ba yana buƙatar ƙarfin kwamfuta mai yawa da ke kusa da allon nunawa, abin da kan taƙaita amfani da fasahar zuwa ɗakunan da aka tanada musamman. An tsara MediVerse ne don mayar da wannan ƙarfin kwamfuta zuwa wani wuri mai nisa, sannan a yaɗa ƙwarewar 3D mai nutsarwa kai tsaye nan take. Likitan tiyata zai iya nuna wa mara lafiya ƙarin da yake shirin cirewa yayin ganawa da shi, ya duba wannan tsarin jiki na musamman na mara lafiyar yayin shirya aikin, sannan ya shiga da wannan hoton har cikin ɗakin tiyata.

Avatar MediVerse ya haɗa fasahohi biyu na Faransa masu cike wa juna gibi. Avatar Medical ta kawo Avatar Medical Vision, manhajarta da ta samu amincewar FDA da alamar CE, wadda ke mayar da hotunan CT da MRI na yau da kullum zuwa hotunan 3D masu mu'amala kamar na zahiri, ba tare da buƙatar rarrabe sassan jiki da hannu ba, tare da gogewar da ta samu wajen aiki da asibitoci sama da 20 a Amurka da Turai. Kyber kuwa tana samar da tsarin ginshiƙi na kai tsaye mai ƙarancin jinkiri matuƙa, wanda ke sarrafa hoton daga nesa tare da yaɗa shi.

Sabanin yaɗa bidiyo na yau da kullum mai shimfiɗaɗɗen fuska, isar da zurfi na gaske yana buƙatar aika hoto daban ga kowane ido nan take, cikin hanzarin da zai sa tsarin jikin ya amsa nan da nan yayin da likita ke motsa shi ko juya shi don ya fi gani sosai.

“Mu'amala da hotunan likitanci kai tsaye nan take na ɗaya daga cikin matsalolin jinkiri mafiya wahala da ake da su,” in ji Jean-Baptiste Kempf, CEO na Kyber. “Jinkirin da ba za a ma lura da shi ba a kiran bidiyo yakan ɓata hoton gaba ɗaya idan kowane ido na karɓar nasa hoton daban. Warware wannan matsala ita ce ke buɗe ƙofar komai. Ta hanyar haɗa fasahar nuna hotuna masu nutsarwa ta Avatar Medical da tsarin ginshiƙin yaɗa bidiyo kai tsaye na Kyber, an tsara MediVerse ne domin wannan mu'amala ta gudana ba tare da tangarɗa ba a wurare da na'urori daban-daban. Wannan babban misali ne na yadda ƙirƙirar fasahar zamani mai zurfi ta Faransa za ta iya magance wata muhimmiyar matsalar kiwon lafiya ta zahiri.”

Ga Avatar Medical, MediVerse muhimmin mataki ne a babban burinta na Basirar Gani don Tiyata, wato samar da bayanan gani na musamman na kowane mara lafiya a duk tsawon tafiyar kulawar tiyata, maimakon ɗaure manyan fasahohin nuna hotuna a kwamfuta ɗaya ko ɗaki ɗaya. Ta hanyar raba ƙarfin kwamfuta da wurin da ake kallon hotunan, MediVerse zai iya sa fasahar nuna hotunan 3D masu mu'amala ta fi sauƙin faɗaɗawa a asibitoci, tsarin kiwon lafiya da wuraren kulawa da ke warwatse a yankuna daban-daban.

“Mun zaɓi gina wannan ne da mafi kyawun fasahar kai tsaye da ake da ita, kuma ta zo daidai cewa ta Faransa ce,” in ji Elodie Litzler, mataimakiyar CEO kuma ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suka kafa Avatar Medical. “Babu ɗayanmu da zai iya yin wannan shi kaɗai. Abin da muke nema ba wai sabbin kayan aiki kawai a asibitoci ba ne, a'a, sauyi ne a yadda marasa lafiya da likitoci ke fahimtar abin da suke kallo, da kuma inda wannan fahimta za ta iya faruwa.”

Ganin cewa an gina shi bisa fasahohin buɗaɗɗen tushe, aikin yana kuma da nufin bai wa asibitoci ƙarin iko a kan tsarin ginshiƙinsu da kuma rage dogaron da suke yi a kan dandamalin nuna hotuna daga nesa na kamfanoni masu keɓantaccen mallaka.

An bayar da tallafin ne ta hanyar kiran neman ayyuka na France 2030 mai taken “Fasahohin Ƙirƙira don Duniyoyin Kama-da-wane Masu Nutsarwa”, bayan wani kwamitin ƙwararru mai zaman kansa ya tantance shi, inda Bpifrance ke kula da aiwatar da shi a madadin gwamnatin Faransa.

Game da Kyber

Kyber kamfani ne na Faransa a fannin fasahar zamani mai zurfi, wanda ke ƙirƙirar tsarin ginshiƙi na kai tsaye don kiwon lafiya, na'urorin mutum-mutumi, sarrafa hotuna a gajimare da kuma manhajojin bidiyo masu amfani da basirar ƙere-ƙere. Ƙara koyo a https://kyber.tech .

Game da Avatar Medical

An kafa ta a shekarar 2020, Avatar Medical na kan gaba a fannin Basirar Gani don Tiyata, tana gina mafita mai iya faɗaɗuwa da ke mayar da hotunan likitanci zuwa bayanan gani masu amfani a aikace a duk tsawon tafiyar kulawar tiyata. Babbar mafitarta, Avatar Medical Vision, tana mayar da hotunan CT da MRI zuwa hotunan 3D masu mu'amala kamar na zahiri nan take, ba tare da rarrabe sassa ba, tana bai wa likitoci hanya mafi sauƙin fahimta don gane tsarin jikin kowane mara lafiya, tsara ayyukan tiyata, haɗa kai da juna da kuma sadarwa da marasa lafiya. Tun daga ganawa da shirye-shiryen kafin tiyata har zuwa ɗakin tiyata, kamfanin na aiki tuƙuru don ganin basirar gani ta kasance a samu a duk inda ake yanke muhimman shawarwarin tiyata. Bisa tushen bincike da aka gudanar a Institut Curie da Institut Pasteur, Avatar Medical na da kayayyakin fasaha da suka samu amincewar FDA da alamar CE. Tana aiki da asibitoci sama da 20 a Amurka da Turai. Ƙara koyo a avatarmedical.ai .
